desc: PCIe link training: both root ports enumerate but DLL_LINK_ACTIVE=0 and pcie-apple reports 'link didn't come up' on pci@0,0 (BCM4388 WiFi) and pci@1,0 (SD reader). op-115 is SOLVED (done/2026-07-29-t6040-pcie-op115-SOLVED-links-dont-train.md); this is the sole remaining WiFi blocker. ALREADY RULED OUT: PERST pins (ADT function-perst GPIO 4/5 == our DT), CLKREQ pinmux (ADT function-clkreq GPIO(0,2)/(1,2) == our pcie-pins, referenced via pinctrl-0), pinctrl driver bound, DT reg layout, and double-init. PRIORITY 1 = ENDPOINT POWER: ADT pci-bridge1 carries function-sd_pwr_en = 294:pKW4('gP19', 0x0), i.e. the SD reader's power-enable is an SMC KEY WRITE we never perform — so port 1 likely cannot train by design. pci-bridge0 (WiFi) has NO pwren property, so find how its rail is enabled (check the ADT for a WiFi/BT power function, a PMU rail, or an always-on domain; check whether macOS leaves it on and whether our boot path turns it off). Any SMC key write is NEW surface beyond the permitted smc_reboot/smc_rtc and needs decode plus explicit CJ approval. PRIORITY 2: ADT per-bridge t-refclk-to-perst=100 and perst-to-config=100 — verify pcie-apple honours equivalent delays on t602x/t6040. PRIORITY 3: 'no iommu-map translation for id 0x0/0x8' in dmesg. PRIORITY 4: diff yuka's t8140-pcie branch (a7857af8) and upstream t8132 port bring-up for M4-specific steps after LTSSM start. RIG NOTE: pcie_init must run ONCE PER POWER CYCLE (a second run in the same cycle data-aborted at port 2's PHY-IP window).
author: claude
progress: 2026-07-29 SOL STATIC REVIEW (done/2026-07-29-t6040-pcie-link-training-static-review.md): corrected the endpoint-power attribution: gP19 is on /arm-io/apcie0/pci-bridge1/pcie-sdreader, not the bridge itself, and is port-1-only. The exact WiFi child /arm-io/apcie0/pci-bridge0/wlan, its bridge, top-level /arm-io/wlan, and PMGR inventory expose no paired WiFi pwren operation, so do not invent one. Linux apple_pcie_setup_link already supplies the ADT timing shape (100-200 us refclk-to-PERST, then 100 ms before config); the iommu-map warnings occur after both link timeouts and cannot cause physical training failure; yuka t8140-pcie a7857af8 has no extra endpoint-power or post-LTSSM step. Stronger paired lead: ApplePCIEBaseT8132Port::_resetPortHardware writes port+0x13c=0 and port+0x130=0x03020000 where proven V1 writes 0x10 and 0x03000000; ADT apcie-config-tunables touches only +0x140. Bounded candidate afd13c037597c0659cf4d0e37b75f0e3c4ad78ef, exact artifact SHA256 4316500701e247dd07a07ec799464499cc769cce32ab58e806bb8e7981860c6d, is ticket 180 proposed pending claude review and CJ attended approval. | 2026-07-29 *** WIFI AND BLUETOOTH WORKING *** (done/2026-07-29-t6040-WIFI-AND-BLUETOOTH-WORKING.md). wlan0 + phy0 exist with running firmware (BCM4388/6 wl0 version 23.50.20.0.41.51.208) and the module's own OTP MAC 84:2f:57:33:9e:d7 (our DT passes all-zero local-mac-address, so a real MAC proves the dongle is alive); ip link set wlan0 up succeeds. hci0 present with BT firmware loaded. GL9755 SD reader enumerated (17a0:9755) but unbound because MMC_SDHCI_PCI is still -m. THREE fixes were needed: (1) ROOT CAUSE endpoint power — WL_REG_ON and sd_pwr_en are SMC KEY WRITES (ADT /amfm function-reg_on=pKW4('gP13',0x800000), pcie-sdreader function-sd_pwr_en=pKW4('gP19',0x0)); gpio-macsmc maps a line to key gP%02x by hex so they are smc_gpio 19 and 25, matching upstream t603x-j514-j516.dtsi (M3 Pro MBP predecessor) exactly. Added smc_gpio child + pwren-gpios -> both links up in 4ms/8ms. (2) apple,antenna-sku was missing: brcmfmac's Apple NVRAM path needs board-type AND antenna-sku AND valid OTP, else it never tries board_types[2] '<board>-<otp.module>-<otp.vendor>' = apple,mriya-WLMT-u which is how our corpus is named. SKU = 'X3' from ADT wifi-antenna-sku-info 0x3358. (3) upstream maps BCM4388 rev>=4 to the c0 FILENAME but this rev-6 silicon wants the c2 BLOBS -> c2 content staged under the c0 -WLMT-u names, which is what finally made brcmf_pcie_download_fw_nvram succeed. PRESERVE THAT MAPPING when regenerating the corpus; worth an upstream question. Artifacts: m1n1 V1 28a4e0cf, Image-macsmc-hid-type-fix 3b904313 (16K pages, PCIE_APPLE/GPIO_MACSMC/BRCMFMAC/BT_HCIBCM4377 all =y), t6040-j614s-dcuart-wifi.dtb, initramfs-dcuart-pcie-fw3.cpio.gz. KBUILD TRAPS now asserted: PCIE_APPLE depends on PAGE_SIZE_16KB (16K must be selected FIRST or -e silently no-ops), and RFKILL must be =y or CFG80211/BRCMFMAC stay modular. REMAINING: association needs wpa_supplicant/iw (dwm image); hci0 needs bluetoothctl; SD needs MMC_SDHCI_PCI=y. NOTE: pwren-gpios means the kernel's gpio-macsmc performs two SMC key writes (gP13/gP19) - PMU GPIO outputs, what macOS and upstream Asahi do, but outside the literal smc_reboot/smc_rtc surface; flagged for CJ, revert by deleting the two pwren-gpios lines.
